name: Nahir dar'Akad
source: Though she possesses a youthful appearance, Queen Nahir dar'Akad of Marbia is a competent and astute leader, adeptly navigating the treacherous waters of court politics while maintaining her position amidst the more powerful and often ruthless neighboring fiefdoms.
